nodes.description: Immutable address of the ERC20 token used by the faucet for transfers
Privileged root address allowed to recover all tokens and to change itself
Mapping(address => uint256) tracking how much each address has claimed
Immutable amount of tokens distributed per successful claim
Public view function returning the already claimed amount for an index
Private function that marks an index as claimed by adding claimAmount
Public airdrop function that validates, marks and transfers tokens to index
Public function that drains the full token balance to _root
Public function that updates the privileged _root address
Constructor initializing token, claimAmount and _root from tx.origin
Caller address used both as a human check and as an authorization check
Transaction origin used for the Only humans check, root authorization and root initialization
External ERC20 transfer call inside Claim sending claimAmount to index
External ERC20 transfer call inside Recovertokens sending the full balance to _root
Arithmetic update claimed[index] += claimAmount performed in _setClaimed
External ERC20 balanceOf call reading the contract token balance
Recipient address parameter of Claim, _setClaimed and ClaimedAmount
New privileged root address parameter of SetRoot
Token contract address parameter of the constructor
Per-claim distribution amount parameter of the constructor
Local variable caching the previous _root value inside SetRoot

edges.reason: Claim requires msg.sender == tx.origin as a guard against contract callers
Claim compares tx.origin with msg.sender, creating a tx.origin dependency check
SetRoot requires msg.sender == _root before allowing a root change
Recovertokens allows the call when msg.sender == _root
Recovertokens allows the call when tx.origin == _root, relying on tx.origin for authorization
Constructor initializes _root with tx.origin, making the root depend on transaction origin
Claim invokes _setClaimed to record the claim before transferring
Claim calls ClaimedAmount to verify the index has not claimed yet
_setClaimed reads and writes the claimed mapping for the given index
_setClaimed performs claimed[index] += claimAmount
The addition result is stored back into the claimed mapping
The index parameter flows into Claim checks and the token transfer recipient
The index parameter flows into _setClaimed as the mapping key
The index parameter flows into ClaimedAmount as the mapping key
SetRoot writes the newroot parameter into the privileged _root state variable
Constructor stores tokenaddr into the immutable token state variable
Constructor stores claim_by_addr into the immutable claimAmount state variable
SetRoot reads _root into the oldroot local variable before overwriting
The oldroot local variable is used within SetRoot logic
SetRoot reassigns the privileged _root state variable
Recovertokens uses _root as the authorization and the transfer recipient
Recovertokens queries the token balance through the external balanceOf call
The balance returned by balanceOf flows back into Recovertokens
Recovertokens performs an external ERC20 transfer that can call back into the contract
The external transfer in Recovertokens may reenter the contract before returning
The allbalance local variable is passed as the amount of the transfer
Recovertokens reads the immutable token address to build the transfer call
Claim executes an external ERC20 transfer, enabling a reentrant callback
The external ERC20 transfer inside Claim can reenter the airdrop logic
The transfer in Claim targets the token contract stored in the token state variable
Claim reads the token state variable to issue the ERC20 transfer
Claim reads claimAmount as both the validity amount and the transfer amount
Constructor assigns the token state variable
Constructor assigns the claimAmount state variable
Constructor assigns the _root state variable

normalization_plan.reason: The index parameter is only meaningful as the recipient argument of the Claim function and its internal calls
The newroot parameter exists solely to be written into _root by SetRoot
The tokenaddr parameter exists only to initialize the token state variable in the constructor
The claim_by_addr parameter exists only to initialize claimAmount in the constructor
The oldroot local variable is a temporary copy of _root used only inside SetRoot
The allbalance local variable is a temporary balance value used only inside Recovertokens
